title: JWT signing secret hardcoded in source with no environment override
description: JWT_SECRET is a source-code literal (sk_live_…) used as HMAC key, readable by anyone with repo access. Allows authentication bypass and privilege escalation. Should read from environment and fail closed at startup.

title: Expiry check fails open for tokens with no `exp` claim
description: Guard uses `if (payload.exp && …)`, so tokens without exp claim are accepted forever despite exp being declared as required. Should require the claim instead of tolerating its absence.
